templates.why_chosen: The only double-column host-device figure in the corpus, with a right-hand legend for within-GPU (solid) vs via-PCIe (dashed) movement.
templates.what_to_learn: At double column, stack GPU memory over CPU memory on the left and run the numbered mechanism left-to-right across both.
